about_the_game:
■ How to Play

Prepare your attack by matching up three blocks!

Use the mouse to shift the tiles vertically or horizontally along the puzzle board.

- The "Keeper" is a single player that can perform three actions.

- The "Hunters" work together on one board and perform one action per player.

 

Once everyone has done their actions, it's time to attack!

The first team to deplete the other's HP wins!

*If there is no decisive winner at the end of five turns, the team with the most HP remaining wins.

 

Special blocks that appear under certain conditions and skills that can be used when specific blocks are matched up make for an exciting and deep tactical experience!

There's more to it than just matching blocks. In this puzzle battle game, you'll need to cooperate with your teammates and observe your opponent's behavior to come up with a good strategy!

■ Features

 Enjoy a unique mix of voxel art with battle and puzzle mechanics!

The main element of battles, the puzzle mechanic is used to attack and defend in a similar fashion to what you would generally see in PvP games.

 

Also, you can customize the voxel art characters to your liking!

Don't forget to watch your voxel art characters hopelessly burst into bits when they lose a battle!

■ Story Mode

Treasure hunters go on an adventure in a board game-styled world in search of hidden treasures that can grant their every wish!

Solve ancient puzzles to take down powerful bosses like the Desert Sphinx, the Red-Hot Ruins Dragon, and the Sea Floor Sanctuary Kraken who are keeping an eye over hidden treasure!

 

These adventurers from all over the world won't be the only ones on this journey! Expect to see bandits and heroic rebels too!

Just what are they looking to wish for...?

 

Skillfully use your unique characters to get hidden treasures to make your wishes come true!
